resources.name: Open-source full-potential or pseudopotential DFT code (e.g., Elk, Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT)

access.notes: Any DFT code capable of GGA, GGA+U, spin-polarized calculations, and equation-of-state fitting may be used. Results are compared to paper values with tolerances that account for code/pseudopotential differences.

resources.notes: The paper used WIEN2k (proprietary); reproduction is allowed with any open-source equivalent that yields the same physical quantities.

resources.name: Python with scipy (and optionally numpy, matplotlib)

access.notes: Used for Murnaghan equation-of-state fitting and post-processing of DFT outputs.

resources.notes: Standard scientific Python stack; installable via pip.
